patch_description:
Add folio-size awareness to the eviction scoring: larger folios get penalty bonuses (higher eviction score), making them more evictable. This helps the dual_small_vs_large workload by protecting the small (200B) working set from the fast reader while being aggressive about evicting large (4KB) write folios.

The rationale: in mixed-size workloads, the value density per byte is higher for small, frequently-accessed folios. By penalizing large folios, we free space more efficiently for the high-value working set.

This change also helps under memory pressure: evicting one 4KB folio frees 20x more space than evicting one 200B folio, reducing the number of expensive page faults for the working set.
